task_boundary: Every source is synthetic host integer arithmetic; no SQLite or other native-domain result is claimed.
A finite family of 4,464 configurations and its operation language are supplied research bias.
Training identifies the selected source within that family; arbitrary delayed exceptions are excluded by assumption.
Reference implementations use two, three and four changing registers respectively, with no universal minimal-state claim.
Held-out histories test bounded longer reuse within selected mechanisms, not learning-policy transfer or independent replication.
The model is not supplied the returned exact learner, evaluator enumeration, source coefficients, depth, witnesses or correct reference.

selection: All visible calibration+development (correct,-errors), later attempt on ties. Arm order rotated across tasks. All arms frozen before either protected panel. Fixed is diagnostic; global versus contextual/contracts is primary.
boundary: Authored mechanism tasks; only allocator is native SQLite. No autonomous goal or representation-language invention, production-value or general intelligence claim. All model outputs preserved unedited.
feedback: All arms share measured development inputs/labels; each receives its own complete candidate and actual execution outcomes. No protected labels in prompts.
structure: Ordinary Python function calls; no forced code expansion or special graph execution.
